command:
set -u; AW=/home/evaluser/aw; CK=$(find "$AW/head-lbl" -name run-checkpoint.sh -path '*scripts*'); python3 -I - "$CK" <<'PY'
import sys
p=sys.argv[1]; s=open(p).read()
a='''jq -e 'type == "object"' >/dev/null 2>&1 <<<"$vj" || vj='''
b='''jq -e 'type == "object"' >/dev/null 2>&1 <<<"$pj" || pj='''
n=s.count(a)+s.count(b)
s=s.replace(a,'[[ -n "$vj" ]] && '+a).replace(b,'[[ -n "$pj" ]] && '+b)
open(p,'w').write(s); print("patched sites:",n)
PY
grep -n '\[\[ -n "\$pj" \]\]\|\[\[ -n "\$vj" \]\]' "$CK"; F=$AW/fx-legacy; now=$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ); printf '{"schema_version":2,"plan_id":"p","state":"RUNNING","status":"RUNNING","timestamps":{"last_activity":"%s"}}\n' "$now" > "$F/.run/sprint-plan-state.json"; rm -f "$F/.run/circuit-breaker.json"; echo "== fixture: sprint-7 in_progress; engineer-feedback-r1..r3.md = legacy 'All good' (no trailer); engineer-feedback.md APPROVED with trailer; cache RUNNING fresh"; echo "== derive --json (label + empty-input guards patched):"; bash "$CK" derive --json --root "$F" 2>&1 | jq -c '{state, cache_state, drift, breaker, legacy: .derivation.legacy_feedback}'; echo "== derive --write:"; bash "$CK" derive --write --root "$F" 2>&1 | head -3; echo "cache now:"; jq -c '{state,status}' "$F/.run/sprint-plan-state.json"; echo "breaker now:"; jq -c '{state, same_issue: .triggers.same_issue, cycle: .triggers.cycle_count.current, history}' "$F/.run/circuit-breaker.json"
